meaning: phr. 工作機會；就業機會

The administrative assistant will look after the arrangements for the upcoming board meeting. (行政助理將負責安排即將舉行的董事會議。)
The new layout makes the office look different and more spacious than before. (新的配置讓辦公室看起來與以往不同，也更加寬敞。)

meaning: phr. 翻閱手冊；查看說明書

She often loses herself in her work when preparing for high-profile client presentations. (準備重要客戶簡報時，她常常全心投入工作。)
The company wellness program includes helpful tips for employees who want to lose weight safely. (公司的健康計畫提供實用建議，協助想安全減重的員工。)
Please check the lost and found office if you have misplaced your personal items on the premises. (如果您在場內遺失個人物品，請到失物招領處查詢。)
The shipment was lost in delivery, and we are currently working with the courier to locate it. (這批貨物在配送途中遺失，我們目前正與快遞公司合作尋找。)
Our community outreach program provides resources to support the needs of every low-income resident. (我們的社區外展計畫提供資源，協助滿足每位低收入居民的需求。)
We value every loyal customer and offer exclusive benefits as a token of our appreciation. (我們珍視每位忠實客戶，並提供專屬優惠以表達謝意。)
Please ensure your luggage tag is securely attached to your bag before checking in. (辦理報到前，請確認行李標籤已牢固繫在行李上。)
The retail market for luxury goods has shown significant growth in the past fiscal year. (奢侈品零售市場在上一個會計年度顯著成長。)

meaning: phr. 郵寄名單；電子郵件名單
example: Please add your email address to our mailing list to receive updates on our latest products. (請將您的電子郵件地址加入我們的郵件名單，以接收最新產品資訊。)

meaning: phr. 維護成本；保養費用
example: The new equipment is designed for durability, which significantly reduces the overall maintenance cost. (新設備以耐用性為設計重點，因此能大幅降低整體維護成本。)

meaning: phr. 養成定期做 A 的習慣
example: It is important to make reviewing daily progress a regular habit for the entire project team. (整個專案團隊養成每日檢視進度的習慣十分重要。)
We intend to make a bid for the government contract during the upcoming auction. (我們打算在即將舉行的招標中競標這份政府合約。)

The company has made a commitment to reducing its carbon footprint by 20% this year. (公司已承諾今年將碳足跡減少 20%。)
If you are unsatisfied with the service, you have the right to make a complaint to the manager. (如果您對服務不滿意，有權向經理提出投訴。)
After reviewing all the data, we were able to make a conclusion regarding the cause of the delay. (檢視所有資料後，我們得以對延誤原因下結論。)

Please make a copy of the contract for our internal files before sending the original to the client. (將合約正本寄給客戶前，請先複印一份供內部存檔。)

The board will make a decision on the proposed expansion plan during next week's meeting. (董事會將於下週會議中決定提出的擴張計畫。)
The logistics team is scheduled to make a delivery to the downtown branch at 10 AM. (物流團隊預定上午 10 點向市中心分部送貨。)
Please make a deposit to the company's account by the end of the day to finalize the transaction. (請於今日結束前將款項存入公司帳戶，以完成交易。)
We are ready to make a final change to the project design before submitting it for approval. (我們準備在提交審核前，對專案設計做最後修改。)
Even experienced professionals may occasionally make a mistake, but it is important to learn from it. (即使是經驗豐富的專業人士偶爾也會犯錯，但重要的是從錯誤中學習。)

meaning: phr. 採取行動；採取措施
example: Given the current market volatility, it is time for us to make a move to protect our investments. (考量目前市場波動劇烈，我們該採取行動保護投資了。)
Please make a note of the action items discussed during the meeting for follow-up. (請記下會議中討論的待辦事項，以便後續追蹤。)

meaning: phr. 特別留意做到；堅持做
example: He makes a point of checking the status of all active projects every morning. (他每天早上一定會檢查所有進行中專案的狀況。)
You will have 15 minutes to make a presentation on your team's achievements this quarter. (您有 15 分鐘時間簡報團隊本季的成果。)
Customers can make a purchase through our secure online store 24 hours a day. (客戶可以全天候透過我們安全的線上商店購物。)
We will make a recording of the seminar for those who are unable to attend in person. (我們會錄下研討會，提供給無法親自出席的人觀看。)
Please submit the form if you wish to make a request for additional office supplies. (如需申請額外的辦公用品，請提交表格。)
The management team will make a response to your proposal by the end of the week. (管理團隊將在本週末前回覆您的提案。)

After evaluating all candidates, the hiring committee will make a selection by Friday. (評估所有候選人後，招聘委員會將於週五前選定人選。)
The CEO was invited to make a speech at the opening ceremony of the new facility. (執行長受邀在新設施的開幕典禮上致詞。)
The bus will make a stop at the main train station before continuing to the airport. (巴士會先在主要火車站停靠，再繼續前往機場。)

I need to make a withdrawal from the business account to cover petty cash expenses. (我需要從公司帳戶提款，以支付零用金支出。)

meaning: phr. 進行調整；做出修正
example: We may need to make adjustments to the project timeline to accommodate the recent changes. (為配合近期的變動，我們可能需要調整專案時程。)
I would like to make an appointment to discuss the current project status with you. (我想預約和您討論目前的專案進度。)
We need to make arrangements for the transportation of the guests arriving from overseas. (我們需要為從海外抵達的賓客安排交通。)
Before we proceed with the project, we need to make an assessment of the potential risks. (繼續執行專案前，我們需要評估潛在風險。)
The accounting department will correct the entry if they find that they made an error. (如果會計部門發現記帳有誤，就會更正該筆分錄。)
We cannot make an exception to the policy, regardless of the unique circumstances. (無論情況多麼特殊，我們都不能對這項政策破例。)
It is important to dress professionally to make a good impression during the job interview. (穿著得體專業，才能在求職面試中留下好印象。)
The manager wanted to make clear that all employees must follow the new safety protocols. (經理想明確表示，所有員工都必須遵守新的安全規範。)

Our primary goal is to provide quality service, but we also need to make money to stay sustainable. (我們的首要目標是提供優質服務，但也需要獲利才能持續經營。)

meaning: phr. 沒有差別；無關緊要
example: It makes no difference which software version we use, as long as it is compatible. (只要相容，使用哪個軟體版本都沒有差別。)
Our quality control standards are strict, and we make no exception for any product line. (我們的品管標準很嚴格，所有產品線一律適用，沒有例外。)
You must dial 9 before you can make an outside call from the office phone. (使用辦公室電話撥打外線前，必須先撥 9。)

meaning: phr. 請自便；像在自己家一樣自在
example: Please make yourself at home while you wait for the director to finish his meeting. (請在這裡自在休息，等主任開完會。)
Please make payment within 30 days of receiving the invoice to avoid late fees. (請在收到發票後 30 天內付款，以免產生逾期費用。)
The company plans to make public its new expansion strategy during the annual shareholders' meeting. (公司計畫在年度股東會上公布新的擴張策略。)
The maintenance team is scheduled to make repairs to the leaky roof this afternoon. (維修團隊預定今天下午修理漏水的屋頂。)
We need to move the old files to make room for the new equipment in the storage area. (我們需要移走舊檔案，為儲藏區的新設備騰出空間。)
Please make sure all doors are locked before you leave the building for the day. (當天離開大樓前，請務必確認所有門都已上鎖。)
The hotel housekeeping staff makes the beds in all rooms every morning. (飯店客房清潔人員每天早上整理所有房間的床鋪。)

meaning: phr. 率先採取行動；先下手
example: In such a competitive market, it is often necessary to make the first move to gain an advantage. (在競爭如此激烈的市場中，通常必須率先行動才能取得優勢。)
The bonus payment is intended to make up for the extra hours worked by the staff. (發放獎金是為了補償員工額外工作的時數。)

meaning: phr. 下定決心；作出決定
example: She took some time to make up her mind regarding which job offer to accept. (她花了一些時間，才決定要接受哪一份工作邀約。)
The company is sponsoring a management seminar for all team leaders next month. (公司下個月將為所有團隊主管贊助一場管理研討會。)

meaning: phr. 市場認知度；品牌知名度
example: The primary goal of the advertising campaign is to increase brand market awareness. (這場廣告活動的主要目標是提升品牌在市場上的知名度。)

meaning: phr. 市占率；市場占有率
example: Our company has successfully increased its market share in the industry by 5% this year. (我們公司今年成功將業界市占率提高了 5%。)

meaning: phr. 市場攤位；市集攤販

The hospital has expanded its maternity ward to accommodate the growing number of patients. (醫院擴建了產科病房，以容納日益增加的患者。)
Each employee is issued a meal pass that can be used at the company cafeteria. (每位員工都會獲發一張可在公司餐廳使用的餐券。)

meaning: phr. 醫療設施；醫療機構
example: The corporation has invested in a new medical facility to provide healthcare for its employees. (企業投資興建新的醫療設施，為員工提供醫療照護。)
The team worked hard to meet their goal of finishing the project ahead of schedule. (團隊努力達成提前完成專案的目標。)

meaning: phr. 趕上期限；如期完成
example: Everyone must work efficiently to ensure that we meet the deadline for the final report. (每個人都必須有效率地工作，確保趕上最終報告的期限。)

meaning: phr. 支付費用；負擔開支
example: The income generated from the project is sufficient to meet the expenses of the initial setup. (專案產生的收入足以支付初期設置費用。)

meaning: phr. 符合要求；達到條件

meaning: phr. 符合標準；達到規範

The updated meeting time has been sent to all participants via email. (更新後的會議時間已透過電子郵件寄給所有與會者。)
I accidentally messed up the final report format, but I have already corrected it. (我不小心弄亂了最終報告的格式，不過已經修正了。)
The company has multiple offices spread throughout the metropolitan area to serve different regions. (公司在都會區各地設有多間辦公室，以服務不同區域。)

meaning: phr. 將……的風險降至最低
example: Regular safety inspections help to minimize the risk of accidents in the workplace. (定期安全檢查有助於將職場事故風險降至最低。)
The airline representative is assisting the passenger in tracking their missing luggage. (航空公司代表正協助乘客追蹤遺失的行李。)
The model number is located on the back of the device, just above the serial number. (型號標示在裝置背面，就在序號上方。)

meaning: phr. 主持會議；調解會議
example: She was asked to moderate a meeting between the two parties to facilitate the discussion. (為了促進討論，她受邀主持雙方的會議。)
The passenger suffered from motion sickness during the rough ferry ride to the island. (乘客搭乘顛簸的渡輪前往島上時，飽受暈船之苦。)
We are ready to move ahead with the next phase of the project as soon as the budget is approved. (預算一經核准，我們就準備推進專案的下一階段。)
The office layout is designed to allow staff to move around easily between workstations. (辦公室的配置旨在讓員工能在各工作站之間輕鬆移動。)

meaning: phr. 繼續推進；向前進展

meaning: phr. 往旁邊移一個座位

He was moved up to a senior management role due to his exceptional performance. (他因表現卓越而獲升任高階管理職。)
The maintenance staff mows the lawn every Friday to keep the office grounds looking tidy. (維護人員每週五修剪草坪，讓辦公園區保持整潔。)

meaning: phr. 令某人非常驚訝的是

meaning: phr. 跨國企業；多國籍公司

The office social club is organizing a session for employees who play a musical instrument. (辦公室社團正為會演奏樂器的員工籌辦交流活動。)

meaning: phr. 我的行程不允許；我目前抽不出時間
example: I would like to assist with the project, but my schedule doesn't permit it at this time. (我很想協助這項專案，但目前行程不允許。)
Please wear your name tag during the conference so that other attendees can easily identify you. (研討會期間請佩戴名牌，方便其他與會者辨認您。)

meaning: phr. 指定代表；指派代表
example: The board appointed a named representative to oversee the merger negotiations. (董事會任命了一位指定代表，負責監督合併談判。)

meaning: phr. 國定假日；國家假日
example: The office will remain closed during the upcoming national holiday. (即將到來的國定假日期間，辦公室將暫停營業。)
The nature reserve protects the natural habitat of several endangered bird species. (這座自然保護區守護數種瀕危鳥類的自然棲息地。)
The network performance needs monitoring to ensure stability during peak hours. (網路效能需要受到監控，以確保尖峰時段維持穩定。)
The company reported a significant increase in net income for the second quarter. (公司報告第二季淨利大幅增加。)
We are pleased to announce the new appointment of Mr. Chen as the Marketing Director. (我們很高興宣布新的人事任命：陳先生將出任行銷總監。)

meaning: phr. 剛到達的；新到貨的
example: The newly arrived shipments of raw materials are currently being inspected. (剛送達的原物料目前正在檢驗。)

meaning: phr. 新成立的；新設立的
example: The newly established research division will focus on sustainable product development. (新成立的研究部門將專注於永續產品開發。)

meaning: phr. 新上市的；新掛牌的
example: Investors are closely tracking the performance of the newly listed tech company. (投資人正密切追蹤這家新上市科技公司的表現。)
The copier is located right next to the break room. (影印機就在休息室旁邊。)
Employees working the night shift receive a special compensation allowance. (上夜班的員工可領取特別津貼。)
Please submit your expense reports no later than Friday afternoon. (請最晚於週五下午前提交費用報告。)
The factory has installed new filters to reduce noise and air pollution in the surrounding area. (工廠已安裝新濾網，以減少周邊地區的噪音與空氣污染。)
We often collaborate with a local non-profit organization for our community service projects. (我們經常與當地非營利組織合作推動社區服務計畫。)
I booked a nonstop flight to Tokyo to save time on my upcoming business trip. (為了節省即將出差的時間，我預訂了飛往東京的直飛航班。)

meaning: phr. 正常營業時間；一般營運時段
example: Our normal operating hours are from 9 AM to 6 PM, Monday through Friday. (我們的正常營業時間為週一至週五上午 9 點至下午 6 點。)

meaning: phr. 不是 A 而是 B
example: The decision was based not on personal preference, but on objective data analysis. (這項決定並非基於個人偏好，而是依據客觀資料分析。)
The new software is not at all difficult to use once you learn the basics. (學會基本操作後，這套新軟體一點也不難用。)
The new warehouse is located not far from the airport for faster logistics. (新倉庫設在離機場不遠處，以便加快物流作業。)

word: not only A but also B
meaning: phr. 不但 A 而且 B
example: The training program not only improved our technical skills but also boosted team morale. (這項培訓計畫不但提升了技術能力，也振奮了團隊士氣。)
Is there a change in the meeting schedule? Not that I'm aware of. (會議時間有變動嗎？據我所知沒有。)

meaning: phr. 更不用說；此外還有
example: The software is very powerful, not to mention its incredibly intuitive user interface. (這套軟體功能強大，更不用說它的操作介面非常直覺。)
The observation tower offers a panoramic view of the entire city. (從觀景塔可以俯瞰整座城市。)

meaning: phr. 過度在意；對……念念不忘
example: While it is good to be detail-oriented, you should not obsess about every minor error. (注重細節固然很好，但不該過度糾結每個小錯誤。)

meaning: phr. 顯然具備資格；明顯適任
example: She is obviously qualified for the position, given her years of experience in the industry. (考量她在業界多年的經驗，她顯然具備這個職位所需的資格。)

meaning: phr. 職業安全與健康；職安衛
example: Our company prioritizes occupational safety and health to ensure a safe working environment. (為了確保安全的工作環境，公司優先重視職業安全與健康。)

meaning: phr. 碰碰運氣；以防萬一
example: I’ll give him a call on the off chance that he is still at the office. (我會打給他，碰碰運氣看他是否還在辦公室。)
The cargo ship is anchored just off the shore, waiting for docking clearance. (貨輪停泊在近岸海面，等待靠港許可。)
The manager decided to offer an apology to the client for the misunderstanding. (經理決定為這次誤會向客戶致歉。)

example: If the app is more user friendly, customers will complete registration faster. (如果這個應用程式更容易使用，客戶就能更快完成註冊。)

meaning: phr. 使用者指南；操作手冊
example: Please refer to the user's guide for installation instructions. (安裝說明請參閱使用者指南。)
We need to contact the utility provider about the power outage. (我們需要聯絡公用事業供應商，詢問停電事宜。)
The company purchased a vacant site for the new factory. (公司購買了一塊空地，準備興建新工廠。)
We are offering a new vacation package for the summer season. (我們為夏季推出了新的度假套裝行程。)
The discount code is valid for thirty days if customers register by Friday. (如果客戶在星期五前註冊，折扣碼就有三十天的有效期。)

meaning: phr. 因對象不同而有所差異
example: The prices for our services vary from client to client. (我們服務的價格因客戶而異。)
There is a vending machine in the hallway for drinks. (走廊裡有一台販賣飲料的自動販賣機。)
We need to break the vicious cycle of low sales and cost-cutting. (我們必須打破銷售低迷與削減成本之間的惡性循環。)

meaning: phr. 視覺輔助教材；視覺教具
example: Please use a visual aid to help explain the new process. (請使用視覺輔助教材來說明新流程。)

meaning: phr. 語音信箱；語音留言
example: Please leave a message on my voice mail if I am away. (如果我不在，請在我的語音信箱留言。)

meaning: phr. 容易受到……影響；易受……攻擊
example: Our computer network is vulnerable to cyber attacks. (我們的電腦網路容易受到網路攻擊。)
We had to wait for a table at the restaurant. (我們在餐廳必須等候座位。)
The conference is full, so we must wait for seats. (會議已經客滿，所以我們必須等候座位。)
We had to wait in line to register for the event. (我們必須排隊等候報名活動。)
The waiter is waiting on a customer at the next table. (服務生正在招待隔壁桌的客人。)
Please have a seat in the waiting room until your turn. (請在等候室入座，直到輪到您。)

meaning: phr. 叫醒電話；晨間喚醒服務
example: I requested a wake-up call for 7:00 AM. (我預約了早上七點的叫醒電話。)

meaning: phr. 帶領參觀；逐步說明
example: The manager will walk through the new facility with us. (經理將帶我們參觀新設施。)
Our office is within walking distance of the subway. (我們的辦公室距離地鐵站很近，步行即可抵達。)

meaning: phr. 步行導覽；徒步觀光
example: We joined a walking tour to learn about the city's history. (我們參加了步行導覽，了解這座城市的歷史。)
We are wary of making quick decisions without data. (我們對於在缺乏資料時倉促做決定會保持謹慎。)
I need to wash the car before the client meeting. (我需要在和客戶開會前洗車。)
The washing machine in the staff breakroom is broken. (員工休息室的洗衣機壞了。)
We decided to watch a film after the long conference. (漫長的研討會結束後，我們決定去看電影。)
He bought a new leather watch band for his watch. (他為手錶買了一條新的皮革錶帶。)
The security guard will watch over the building at night. (保全人員會在夜間看守這棟建築。)
The water level in the reservoir is very low this year. (今年水庫的水位非常低。)
Please remember to water the plants in the office. (請記得替辦公室裡的植物澆水。)
The watering can is kept in the storage room. (澆水壺放在儲藏室裡。)
The machine shows signs of normal wear and tear. (這台機器有正常耗損的跡象。)
These shoes will wear out if you walk in them daily. (如果每天穿著走路，這雙鞋會磨損。)
I checked the weather forecast before planning the outdoor event. (規劃戶外活動前，我先查看了天氣預報。)

meaning: phr. 氣象報告；天氣資訊
example: The weather report says it will rain all afternoon. (氣象報告指出，整個下午都會下雨。)

meaning: phr. 重量上限；載重限制
example: The elevator has a maximum weight limit of 500kg. (這部電梯的最大載重限制為 500 公斤。)
Please book meeting rooms well in advance, because next month’s schedule is crowded. (請提早預訂會議室，因為下個月的行程很滿。)
When it comes to technical support, he is the best. (談到技術支援，他是最出色的。)
Would you like some whipped cream on your coffee? (您想在咖啡上加些鮮奶油嗎？)
She worked hard to win a contest for the best design. (她努力爭取贏得最佳設計比賽。)

meaning: phr. 贏得合約；獲得承包案
example: We managed to win a contract with a new major client. (我們成功取得一位新大型客戶的合約。)
Before leaving for the meeting, Mr. Chen winds his watch each morning. (陳先生每天早上出門開會前都會替手錶上發條。)
The store changed its window display for the holiday season. (這家店為假期更換了櫥窗展示。)
Please wipe off the dust from the screen. (請擦掉螢幕上的灰塵。)
Please wire money to our bank account for the payment. (請將款項電匯至我們的銀行帳戶。)
Because the invoice is overdue, payment must be completed by wire transfer today. (由於發票已逾期，款項必須在今天以電匯方式付清。)
With respect to your question, I will follow up by email with the requested details. (關於您的問題，我會透過電子郵件補上所需細節。)
Everyone attended the meeting with the exception of the manager. (除了經理以外，所有人都出席了會議。)
If staff leave with the lights on, monthly utility costs will increase unnecessarily. (如果員工離開時沒有關燈，每月公用事業費用就會不必要地增加。)
We are happy to accommodate your requests within reason. (我們樂意在合理範圍內配合您的要求。)
This is without a doubt our best performing product. (這無疑是我們表現最出色的產品。)
Please submit the revised contract without delay, because the client is waiting for approval. (請立即提交修訂後的合約，因為客戶正等候核准。)

meaning: phr. 未經通知；事先未告知
example: If prices change without notice, distributors may challenge the updated terms. (如果價格在未經通知的情況下變動，經銷商可能會質疑更新後的條款。)
We evaluate all applications without respect to age. (我們評估所有申請時不考慮年齡。)
You cannot use the data without the consent of the owner. (未經資料所有者同意，您不得使用這些資料。)

meaning: phr. 加班；額外工作時數
example: We have to work additional hours to meet the deadline. (我們必須加班才能趕上截止期限。)
We strive to provide a positive work environment for everyone. (我們努力為每個人提供正向的工作環境。)
Please attach your work history to your resume. (請在履歷中附上您的工作經歷。)
We will work in groups for this training exercise. (這次訓練活動我們會分組合作。)
We are currently working on a new marketing strategy. (我們目前正在制定新的行銷策略。)
He often has to work overtime to finish his tasks. (他常常必須加班才能完成工作。)
If the payment terminal does not work properly, cashiers should contact IT immediately. (如果付款終端機無法正常運作，收銀員應立即聯絡資訊部門。)
If demand increases during holidays, supervisors may extend each work shift temporarily. (如果假日期間需求增加，主管可能會暫時延長每個班次。)

meaning: phr. 工作條件；工作環境
example: If working conditions improve, employee turnover is likely to decrease next quarter. (如果工作條件改善，下季度的員工離職率可能會下降。)
She is busy wrapping a present for her colleague. (她正忙著替同事包裝禮物。)
Let's wrap up this meeting and go to lunch. (我們結束這場會議，去吃午餐吧。)
Please write down the important points from the presentation. (請記下簡報中的重點。)
I need to write up a report on the meeting outcomes. (我需要撰寫一份會議成果報告。)

meaning: phr. 書寫便箋本；便條紙
example: I keep a writing pad on my desk for notes. (我在桌上放了一本便箋本來記錄事項。)
You need written authorization to access this server. (您需要取得書面授權才能存取這部伺服器。)
Please obtain written consent from the client before proceeding. (繼續進行前，請先取得客戶的書面同意。)
